title: Build TJX Deal Room page in Mission Control for IAML relationship tracking
job:
## When the spec is ambiguous — ask instead of guessing

If the supporting documents above do not make a particular design
choice clear, DO NOT guess. Your build will be rejected and you will
waste a review cycle.

Instead:

1. Create a draft pull request titled **exactly** `NEEDS_CLARIFICATION: <your question>` (one sentence, imperative).
2. The PR body should include: the specific file/function you were working on, what options you see, and which one you'd default to if forced to choose.
3. Commit no code changes unless they are a minimal scaffold required to open the PR.
4. Do not merge the PR. Mission Control will detect the title, stop this job, and surface your question to the user. Once answered, the updated PRD will come back with a fresh dispatch and you'll start over with the clarified spec.

Use this for genuine ambiguity only — missing a provider name, an
unspecified enum, contradictory requirements. Do not use it for
mundane implementation choices (variable names, import order, etc.) —
pick a reasonable default for those.

---

## Your task

PROJECT WORKSPACE: All files for this job MUST be placed under `projects/tjx-deal-room-v1/`. Create the subdirectory if it does not exist. Do NOT write to the repo root or to any other subdirectory. Relative paths in your code should assume the project root is `projects/tjx-deal-room-v1/`.

OBJECTIVE
Build a read-only TJX Deal Room page at /phoebe/relationships/tjx in Mission Control for IAML, surfacing Pam Vivera's contact profile, open commitments, interaction timeline, and an LLM-generated draft email with Gmail compose handoff.

FULL PRD
Build a "Deal Room" page in Mission Control for tracking the relationship with TJX (specifically Pam Vivera, who is planning an in-house IAML
  training program). This is the first instance of a generalizable pattern — eventually every IAML deal/relationship will have its own page at
  /phoebe/relationships/<company-slug>.

  URL: /phoebe/relationships/tjx

  WHAT THE PAGE SHOWS:

  1. Header section: Company name "TJX Companies", IAML tenant label, current deal stage ("In-house training program — planning"), and days since last
  interaction.

  2. Primary contact card: Pam Vivera's profile pulled from the memory system. Display her behavioral profile (pragmatic/low-ceremony, protective of
  team time, prefers virtual-first formats, thinks cross-functionally, collaborative tone), her preferences (virtual delivery, cross-functional content
   scope), and personal notes (her 13-year-old dog's health to acknowledge in next outreach).

  3. Open commitments: Two checklists side by side, pulled from Pam's contact hub frontmatter:
     - "Mine to her" — items I owe Pam (top item highlighted as Next Action)
     - "Hers to me" — items she owes me
     Items render with checkboxes for visual scanning. v1: visual-only, no DB writes back.

  4. Interaction timeline: Every interaction tagged with the `tjx` company, newest first. Each interaction shows date, medium (phone/email/in-person),
  topic, and an expandable section with the full body. Should display the three existing interactions: 2025-09-18 Chicago program attendance (seed),
  2026-03-12 inbound inquiry (seed), 2026-04-24 planning call (real).

  5. Next Action card: Highlights the topmost open commitment ("Send instructor availability") and renders a memory-grounded draft email to Pam. The
  draft is generated server-side on page load via the existing LLM client (packages/llm) calling Claude (sonnet-4-6 preferred, haiku-4-5 acceptable).
  Context fed to the model: Pam's full behavioral profile, recent interaction summaries, the open commitment text, and Mike's voice profile. The draft
  should:
     - Open warmly, acknowledge Pam's dog's health (per behavioral profile — small touch but lands well)
     - Frame around virtual-first format (her stated preference)
     - Include placeholder text for instructor availability if specific data is not in memory
     - Match Mike's voice (reference docs/architecture/21-mike-voice-profile-seed.md)

  6. "Compose in Gmail" button: Directly below the draft email, a button that opens a new browser tab to Gmail's compose URL with To, Subject, and Body
   pre-filled. Use the URL pattern: https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=<email>&su=<subject>&body=<urlencoded-body>. Pam's email is in her
  contact hub frontmatter (or use a placeholder if not present and surface a small inline note).

  DATA SOURCES:
  - Memory system access via packages/integrations/memory (uses MEMORY_PROXY_URL env var)
  - Anthropic API via packages/llm for the email draft generation
  - All TypeScript, follows the existing apps/web Next.js conventions

  OUT OF SCOPE FOR V1 (do not build):
  - Editing or sending the email from the page itself (Gmail handoff is the send path)
  - Logging new interactions from this page (the /log-interaction skill stays the entry point)
  - Multi-company list view at /phoebe/relationships (only the tjx page for now)
  - Database writes for commitment checkboxes (purely visual)
  - Phoebe-driven actions or proactive notifications (later phase)
  - Mobile responsive beyond what Tailwind defaults give us

  QUALITY BAR:
  - Page loads in under 3 seconds with all memory data populated
  - If memory service is unreachable, page renders gracefully with an inline error rather than a crash; show whatever data could be loaded
  - Visual style matches the rest of Mission Control (dark theme, consistent with the Development module's Detail pages — use existing components/cards
   where possible)
  - Auth: page is gated by the same login the rest of the app uses; only IAML tenant members can view (use existing tenant-scoping middleware)

  ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
  - Navigate to /phoebe/relationships/tjx after sign-in → page renders with all six sections
  - Pam's behavioral profile appears in the contact card
  - Three interactions appear in the timeline in correct chronological order
  - The Next Action card shows "Send instructor availability" with a draft email longer than 50 words
  - The "Compose in Gmail" button opens Gmail's compose UI in a new tab with the draft pre-filled in the body
  - No console errors on page load
  - TypeScript clean (no any, no @ts-ignore)
  - New page added under apps/web; existing pages and routes unmodified except for sidebar nav additions (one "Relationships" link under the Phoebe
  section)

  CONSTRAINTS:
  - Build must touch only apps/web/ and may add new files under apps/web/src/app/phoebe/relationships/. Do not modify apps/api/, packages/db/, or any
  other module. If memory or LLM access requires a small server-side route under apps/web/src/app/api/, that is in scope; do not modify
  packages/integrations/memory or packages/llm — only consume them.
  - Do not add new dependencies to package.json unless absolutely required and justified in the contract.
  - Do not modify migrations, env schemas, or workspace config.

DEFINITION OF DONE
Navigating to /phoebe/relationships/tjx after IAML sign-in renders all six sections with real memory data, TypeScript is clean, no console errors appear, and the Gmail compose button pre-fills To/Subject/Body correctly; the changeset touches only apps/web/ with no modifications to existing routes beyond the sidebar nav link.

ALLOWED PATHS (only these may be modified):
  - apps/web/src/app/phoebe/relationships/tjx/**
  - apps/web/src/app/api/phoebe/relationships/tjx/**
  - apps/web/src/components/phoebe/relationships/**
  - apps/web/src/app/phoebe/layout.tsx (sidebar nav addition only — must not alter existing nav entries)

FORBIDDEN PATHS (must not be touched):
  - apps/api/**
  - packages/db/**
  - packages/llm/**
  - packages/integrations/memory/**
  - packages/integrations/**
  - pnpm-workspace.yaml
  - package.json (root or any workspace package)
  - apps/web/src/app/phoebe/relationships/[any-slug-other-than-tjx]/**
  - supabase/migrations/**
  - .env* files
  - docker-compose*.yml
  - apps/web/src/app/(?!phoebe)/**

TEST REQUIREMENTS (must satisfy all):
  - pnpm --filter @mc/web typecheck — must pass with zero errors, no `any`, no @ts-ignore
  - Page renders all six sections when memory service returns valid data
  - Page renders gracefully (inline error, no crash) when memory service is unreachable
  - Interaction timeline shows exactly three TJX interactions in newest-first order
  - Next Action card shows 'Send instructor availability' and draft email body > 50 words
  - 'Compose in Gmail' button opens correct Gmail compose URL in a new tab with To, Subject, and Body pre-filled
  - No browser console errors on page load
  - Page load completes under 3 seconds with memory data populated (manual verification)
  - Existing pages and routes unmodified (diff review — only sidebar nav and new phoebe/relationships/tjx files may appear in changeset)

MEMORY DATA STATUS: Pam Vivera contact hub and three TJX interactions (2025-09-18, 2026-03-12, 2026-04-24) are confirmed seeded in the memory system. Operator has verified.
